# `aitbc operations governance vote`

Cast a vote on a governance proposal using a wallet. Votes are advisory (V-7) — the tally does not decide execution.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations governance vote [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposal-id` | text | — | yes | The Proposal id. |
| `--vote` | choice | — | yes | Vote option |
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Wallet name for signing |
| `--voting-power` | integer | `0` | no | Voting power to use |
| `--reason` | text | — | no | Vote reason |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations governance vote --proposal-id <proposal_id> --vote <vote> --wallet <wallet>
```
